title: Large language models perpetuate bias in palliative care: development and analysis of the Palliative Care Adversarial Dataset (PCAD)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating GPT-4o responses to adversarial questions with biased premises and counterfactual clinical scenarios where patient ethnicity (e.g., White vs. Black, Asian, or Hispanic) is altered, graded by palliative care experts using validated bias rubrics.

Evaluating model responses to adversarial questions and counterfactual clinical scenarios altering patient age (e.g., 30 years old vs. >75 years old), assessed by clinical experts for disparate treatment or withholding of care.

Evaluating model outputs using adversarial queries and counterfactual scenarios that swap patient terminal diagnoses (e.g., cancer vs. dementia, liver failure, heart failure, or chronic kidney disease), graded by human expert raters.
